findings.description: The source rejects literal link-local IPv4 destinations for this caller URL before the request. This candidate does not allege an initial literal link-local bypass. Other destinations, DNS, redirects and IPv6 protection remain unestablished.
findings.remediation: Permit only required HTTP(S) destinations, reject private and loopback addresses, and enforce checks on every requested URL and redirect.
findings.title: Server-side request forgery
